appointer._note: F-04 (D-69): the independent appointer of auditors. Fixed at genesis; a pre-F-04 database binds it once. null = no appointer, so nobody can audit. Deployments set it via data/appointer.json (python -m medb.api) or a config override.

audit.suspend_on_note: AUDIT_INDETERMINACY is never in suspend_on: per spec II-C it means re-audit required, no automatic suspension (F-08, D-40)

templates.unconfirmed: MedB inference, not confirmed by you: {statement}

anchoring._note: Optional external anchoring of stream-head hashes (F-13, D-62). Off by default; only hashes leave the machine.

integrations._note: All integrations are OFF by default (D-72..D-75). Enable locally in data/integrations.json (merged by python -m medb.api and the MCP server); never needs network beyond 127.0.0.1.

mcp._note: MCP stdio server (python -m medb.integrations.mcp_server). Acts as these token actors through the local API; never the user. tools: null = all MCP tools.

importers._note: User-only local file importers (corpus.ingest; ingest grant required). Files only, under allowed_roots (relative to the repo root). formats: null = every recognised format; unknown formats are refused.

sync._note: Live account sync (D-76..D-78). OFF by default; per-service opt-in by the user in data/integrations.json. Outbound HTTPS only, to the per-provider host allowlist in medb/integrations/sync_http.py. OAuth client ids/secrets live in data/sync_clients.json and tokens in data/sync_tokens/ (both gitignored; never in this config, which is recorded at GENESIS and exported). Ingest grants for source sync:<service> are required.

outbox._note: Append-only local notification feed (ids and kinds only, no content). Optional webhook to http://127.0.0.1 or http://[::1] only.
